description:
Returns a set of context-aware reflection questions to guide a career journaling session. Use this at the start of any journaling conversation to orient the discussion.

The tool reads the user's GigHQ experience records and existing career entries to tailor the questions — surfacing the most relevant role, estimating tenure, and flagging roles with sparse documentation.

Session types:
  achievement — document a specific win or impact
  quarterly   — end-of-quarter reflection (default)
  onboarding  — first 90 days at a new role
  wrap-up     — leaving a role or wrapping up an internship
  job-search  — actively applying; synthesise story and close gaps

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

session_type.description: Type of journaling session. Defaults to 'quarterly'.

name: get_career_journal_prompts
